item.description: Killington Resort will host the women's World Cup giant slalom and slalom races over Thanksgiving weekend. Snowmaking crews prepared the course despite early weather challenges. The event includes live music and community activities alongside the races.

Police found a dead woman in a ditch near the CVS in South Burlington on Saturday. The woman was likely in her thirties and showed no signs of struggle or injuries. Authorities suspect no foul play and are asking anyone with information to come forward.
Vermont's unemployment rate stayed at two point six percent in October. The state ranks fourth lowest nationally. Labor force participation held steady at sixty-two point one percent.

Vermont officials remind hunters to process deer taken out of state before bringing them into Vermont. This helps prevent chronic wasting disease from spreading. The disease is always fatal and targets brain tissue.
